key_events: Apple Inc. launched the foldable iPhone Duo on September 11, 2026.
John Ternus debuted as Apple Inc.'s CEO on September 9, 2026, introducing the foldable iPhone Duo.
The foldable iPhone Duo has a premium starting price of $1,999.
Analysts questioned the appeal of the foldable iPhone Duo beyond wealthy tech enthusiasts.
Apple demonstrated the device running Zoom, Slack, and Netflix at the launch event.
AAPL.summary: Apple Inc. recently launched the foldable iPhone Duo, priced at $1,999, under the leadership of new CEO John Ternus. While the device showcases popular applications like Zoom, Slack, and Netflix, analysts remain skeptical about its broader market appeal beyond affluent tech enthusiasts.

key_events: Microsoft plans to expand its global data center capacity to more than 38 gigawatts by 2032
Microsoft added a tool called Code to its Copilot app on September 25
The AI gold rush is fueling a record tech bond boom
Michael Burry commented on Big Tech's AI commitments
BNP Paribas upgraded Synopsys to Neutral from Underperform
MSFT.summary: Microsoft is set to significantly enhance its global data center capacity to over 38 gigawatts by 2032, reflecting its commitment to expanding infrastructure amid the ongoing AI boom. Additionally, the recent introduction of a new tool called Code to its Copilot app further positions Microsoft as a leader in the tech sector, contributing to a positive sentiment around its stock, which is currently priced at $516.17, up 3.99% over the past 30 days.

key_events: Nvidia looks to benefit from China chip demand
Elon Musk announced SpaceX's Colossus 2 supercomputer could double its number of Nvidia GPUs by year-end
NVDA.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is poised for growth as it stands to benefit from increased chip demand in China, alongside positive developments in the AI sector following Meta's advancements. Additionally, Elon Musk's announcement regarding SpaceX's Colossus 2 supercomputer potentially doubling its Nvidia GPU count by year-end further underscores the company's strong market position, with NVDA's stock currently priced at $225.07, reflecting a 7.35% increase over the past 30 days.
